Recipes shows the visit as one card with its note; a Served plate opens with its photo, the honest line its numbers each with a range, and its foods; Share the numbers draws the picture and opens the share sheet; I ate this asks the day and the meal and puts your dishes in as one meal. The read is a stand-in (no AI here). Changed by story DT305 (0.3.151, boards Stories230 and Stories231; Coach Milan 16 November 2026, Go 11:35): a photo waits on the photo screen, which has no chips, and Read the plate reads it. Just looking is chosen behind the pencil of the meal line. After a read of your own meal the read shows alone; Change the foods opens the plate. 0.3.157 (DT308, the meal model; Coach Milan, Go 18 November 11:14), changed by the story: Just looking is the last row of the calendar behind the pencil (just-looking.cjs), in place of the chip under What is it for; a meal is tapped in that calendar, and with a meal set the X clears it first. Changed by DT318 (0.3.160, board DT318; Coach Milan 19 November 01:00, Go): the link Wrong foods? Help Chef Mealan read it is gone; the form opens with one more photo of the same plate, behind ＋ Photo (one-more-photo.cjs). Changed by B150 (0.3.160, board B150; Coach Milan 19 November 01:00, Go): Just looking and No meal selected are one state, and a photo read with no meal selected is a photo of yours. A plate is kept as Served with Don't count it (not-counted.cjs): it starts as not counted, someone else's, with Main picked by hand, and a tap on Mine makes it mine. Scan another plate reads the dish as before. changed by DT349 (0.3.193, AC9): Change it first is Put it on the Plate, in What do you do with it?
